version_name: Version 1.4.0 treatment-plan date clock, workflow exports, and Alleva readiness guidance
description: Adds the local date-clock treatment-plan evaluator with PHP 30-day, non-PHP 60-day, and configurable unvalidated LOC-change presets; logs each timeliness analysis with workflow version context; includes workflow-step statuses in CSV/JSON exports; records source evidence locations; supports draft workflow editing; improves API settings validation and Alleva OpenAPI/FHIR guidance; and updates safe fallback names for missing patient names.
